messages.subject: Urgent - replacement spindle bearings for PX-180/PX-220
messages.plaintextBody:
Hello,

Following our call, we need to expedite conforming angular-contact spindle bearings to replace a failed batch. Spec attached separately (ES-4471 Rev C, 60 HRC minimum, 30,000 hr L10). We will need around 1,240 units. Can you confirm lead time and pricing for an expedited order?

Henry Doyle
Operations Director
Pennington Industries Limited

messages.subject: RE: Urgent - replacement spindle bearings for PX-180/PX-220
messages.plaintextBody:
Henry,

We can meet ES-4471 to 60 HRC and certify hardness per batch. For 1,240 units on an expedited build, unit price is £228.30 plus carriage, lead time 3 weeks. Certificates of conformity included.

Karen
Northvale Metals Limited
